scenarios.title: Prowess triggers when its controller casts a noncreature spell

setup.notes: Monastery Swiftspear is a 1/2 with haste and prowess.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; the prowess trigger resolves, then Shock resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Prowess triggers on the cast: Monastery Swiftspear is 2/3 until end of turn. B takes 2 damage and is at 18.

variants.label: creature-spell
variants.delta: A casts Grizzly Bears (tapping Forest and Mountain) instead of Shock.
variants.expected: Prowess does not trigger: Monastery Swiftspear stays 1/2. Grizzly Bears enters the battlefield.

variants.label: opponent-casts
variants.delta: A casts nothing; B casts Shock targeting A, tapping Mountain.
variants.expected: Prowess does not trigger on B's spell: Monastery Swiftspear stays 1/2. A takes 2 damage and is at 18.

scenarios.title: Each instance of prowess triggers separately

setup.notes: Triton Wavebreaker was cast bestowed earlier and is a bestowed Aura on Monastery Swiftspear: enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has prowess, so Swiftspear has two instances of prowess and is 2/3. Remove Triton Wavebreaker in the single-instance variant, where Swiftspear is 1/2.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; the prowess triggers resolve, then Shock resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Two prowess triggers resolve: Monastery Swiftspear gets +2/+2 until end of turn and is 4/5. B is at 18.

variants.label: single-instance
variants.delta: Triton Wavebreaker is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: One prowess trigger resolves: Monastery Swiftspear is 2/3 until end of turn. B is at 18.

scenarios.forge_notes: The bestowed state of the pre-placed Aura is not expressible in the zone list; the harness must set it up as if cast bestowed.
